items.label: Core Idea
items.subtitle: A modular third-person character controller template with physics, camera, and animation.

items.label: Gameplay
items.subtitle: Move, jump, and dash a character through a 3D space with responsive, physics-driven controls.

items.label: Mechanics
items.subtitle: Component-based state machine drives movement, jump, and dash via modular ability scripts.

items.label: Game Feel
items.subtitle: Responsive and snappy with smooth acceleration curves, coyote time, and camera polish.
